paragraphs.text: The Mox Jasper is a legendary artifact and mox jewel seen on Tarkir during the time of the Dragonstorms .

The Mox Jasper was formed on Tarkir after the Dragonstorms imbued the land itself with the essence of dragonfire. As a jewel, it appears to be a blue and red stone within a medallion worn around the neck. It has also been depicted as a large red stone shaped like a dragon egg and a blue and red stone surrounded by rocks shaped into dragon claws. It appears to draw mana from dragons .
